item.title: Critical Care Management of Disaster-Related Organ Failure.
item.description: Disasters generate high volumes of multisystem trauma while simultaneously degrading the staff, equipment, and electricity that critical care depends on. item.description: This article provides a practical overview of modern trauma resuscitation for emergency clinicians. Guidance is provided on fluid resuscitation, permissive hypotension, airway management, and treatment of agitation in critically ill trauma patients.
